edges.sentence: On 2026-10-01, NPR reported “the 37-year-old killed last January by a federal agent during the Trump administration's immigration enforcement surge in Minnesota”; on the same day, The Hill reported “The family and partner of Renee Good, the 37-year-old mother killed by an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officer in Minneapolis, filed lawsuits Wednesday against the federal government and President Trump for damages following the shooting.”.

On 2026-10-01, NPR reported “The family of Renee Good, the 37-year-old killed last January by a federal agent during the Trump administration's immigration enforcement surge in Minnesota, filed two civil lawsuits against the federal government Thursday.”; on 2026-10-02, NPR reported “Renee Good's family filed two civil lawsuits against the federal government yesterday over her death last January.”.

On 2026-10-01, PBS NewsHour reported “The two lawsuits were filed”; on 2026-10-02, NPR reported “Renee Good's family filed two civil lawsuits against the federal government yesterday over her death last January.”.

On 2026-10-01, PBS NewsHour reported “The two lawsuits were filed”; on the same day, NPR reported “The family of Renee Good, the 37-year-old killed last January by a federal agent during the Trump administration's immigration enforcement surge in Minnesota, filed two civil lawsuits against the federal government Thursday.”.

On 2026-10-01, Reuters reported “The lawsuits describe Good as a poet and mother of three children, and that she and her wife, Becca Good, dropped their 6-year-old son off at school before stopping her car in the middle of Portland Avenue after seeing patrolling ICE agents.”; on the same day, NPR reported “Renee Good had three children, and Becca is still raising their youngest, a 6-year-old.”.
